_about: Books to publish, in order. The monthly job publishes the first entry without data/books/<slug>/book.json and without a skip reason. lv = LibriVox audiobook id (a solo reading), pg = Project Gutenberg ebook number (an HTML edition, illustrated where possible), published = year of first publication (must be in the US public domain).

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.blurb: Alice follows a White Rabbit down a hole into a world of riddles, tea parties and a furious Queen.

books.title: A Christmas Carol
books.author: Charles Dickens
books.blurb: On Christmas Eve, the miser Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by his dead partner and three spirits.

books.title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
books.author: L. Frank Baum
books.blurb: A cyclone carries Dorothy to the land of Oz, where she sets off along the yellow brick road to find the Wizard.
books.skip: the Gutenberg edition has no public-domain statement

books.title: Through the Looking-Glass
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.blurb: Alice climbs through the mirror into a land laid out like a chessboard, and sets out to become a queen.

books.title: The Time Machine
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.blurb: A Victorian inventor travels to the year 802,701 and finds humanity split into two strange species.

books.title: The Jungle Book
books.author: Rudyard Kipling
books.blurb: Mowgli is raised by wolves, taught by Baloo and Bagheera, and hunted by the tiger Shere Khan.

books.title: Peter Pan
books.author: J. M. Barrie
books.blurb: The boy who won't grow up teaches Wendy and her brothers to fly, and takes them to Neverland.

books.title: Treasure Island
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.blurb: Young Jim Hawkins finds a pirate's map and sails for buried treasure with the charming, dangerous Long John Silver.

books.title: The Wind in the Willows
books.author: Kenneth Grahame
books.blurb: Mole, Rat, Badger and the reckless Mr. Toad share adventures along the river and in the Wild Wood.

books.title: The Secret Garden
books.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
books.blurb: Lonely Mary Lennox finds a locked garden on a Yorkshire estate and brings it, and her cousin, back to life.

books.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.blurb: Twelve cases for Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson, from A Scandal in Bohemia to The Copper Beeches.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.blurb: Victor Frankenstein builds a living being and abandons it, and his creation demands a reckoning.

books.title: Anne of Green Gables
books.author: L. M. Montgomery
books.blurb: Red-haired orphan Anne Shirley talks her way into the hearts of an elderly brother and sister on Prince Edward Island.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.blurb: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy misjudge each other, at length and with wit, in Regency England.
